name: Orb of Dragonkind

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book. Artifact random properties use the game's condensed tables (deviations.md).

powers.name: Call Dragons

params.text: sends out a call to every chromatic dragon within 40 miles

powers.text: Magic action: chromatic dragons within 40 miles are drawn to the Orb, though not friendly to you.

summary: A dragon-trapping orb: healing and warding spells, Scrying, and a call no chromatic dragon can ignore.
text: Long ago, when elves and humans were losing a desperate war against evil dragons, a circle of mighty wizards pooled their greatest magic to forge five Orbs of Dragonkind, each holding an evil dragon's essence. Attuning means making a Charisma saving throw against DC 15; fail it and the dragon inside dominates you. Once attuned, you can cast each of these from the Orb once per dawn (save DC 18): Daylight, Death Ward, Scrying and Cure Wounds (level 9). You can also send out a call that reaches chromatic dragons within 40 miles. Every Orb carries two minor beneficial properties, one minor detrimental property and one major detrimental property.
